declarations.coverage: Drafted from the repository tree by `discovery/draft-documentation-scope.mjs`: every file Git keeps under the documentation root `docs`, a new index for each of its directories without one, the development guide, and the domain glossaries and context maps the rules identify. Paths other declarations own are left out, and so is each README.md outside the documentation roots. Link-repair files and move destinations enter when the work needs them. Current repository evidence resolves the four drafter questions: include root authoring-notes.md in place as the maintained author decision record beside standards.yaml; exclude THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md as legal notice text, discovery and guidance as standards source instructions, and vendor as preserved third-party material. docs is the only documentation root. Existing indexes cover all its directories. No moves, missing indexes, or additional link-repair paths are indicated by the current tree and reviewed guidance. README.md is governed separately by repository-readme. The earlier proposal supplies discovery context only; these decisions are based on the current repository.

declarations.coverage: The project-content scope is intentionally empty: canonical-labels and pull-request-integration configure only remote GitHub settings. The sole origin fetch/push URL is https://github.com/lutzseverino/repo-canon; authenticated read-only GitHub lookup confirms lutzseverino/repo-canon, default branch main, and viewer permission ADMIN. The later confirmation must authorize the disclosed remote fixes; this proposal and inspection perform none.

This repository is a single standards source with one root manifest, `package.json`, and one set of development commands, and it has no nested Project. Every nested directory is standards source, executable tooling, tests and fixtures, vendored third-party material, documentation, or installed agent material. There is therefore no non-root Project README to propose, and the scope is intentionally empty.
